During a period of time, the trends of the population number, individual weight, and total population weight of this fish species changing with time are shown in the figure. If the fish did not reproduce during this period, then the curves in the figure representing population number, individual weight, and total population weight are respectively?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A batch of fish fry of a certain species was released into a fish pond. During a period of time, the trends of the population number, individual weight, and total population weight of this fish species changing with time are shown in the figure. If the fish did not reproduce during this period, then the curves in the figure representing population number, individual weight, and total population weight are respectively?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is labeled "time", and the vertical axis represents the amount of change. There are three curves: C is at a relatively high position near the time starting point, then continuously decreases and approaches a relatively low level; B starts from a relatively low position and gradually rises, and tends to level off in the later stage; A starts from a relatively low position and rises, reaches a peak, and then gradually decreases. Then reason: The stem states that what was released was fish fry, and that there was no reproduction during this period. No reproduction means that the population number will not increase due to birth, and can only decrease due to death and other reasons, so population number corresponds to C, which continuously decreases. Fish fry will grow and develop, and individual weight increases with time, and after reaching a certain stage the growth slows, so individual weight corresponds to B. Total population weight = population number × individual weight. In the early stage, obvious individual weight gain causes the total weight to rise; in the later stage, the effect of the decrease in population number increases and causes the total weight to decrease, so total population weight corresponds to A, which first rises and then falls.
